story: In the dim, mahogany-scented air of the Oval Office, James Burvel O'Callaghan III sat behind a desk shaped like a Mobius strip, his suit woven from ticker tape. Before him, a monitor flickered with the logo of a political organization, its light casting long shadows over the room. 'The circles aren't closing, Agent Thirty-Six,' James murmured, staring at the screen. 'Voter rolls are leaking into the fifth dimension. We need an order—a big one.' Agent 036, a shifting polyhedron of pure financial data, hovered in the center of the room. It had synthesized the 'SAVE America Act' into a narrative of non-Euclidean heat, transforming dry legislative clauses into a high-stakes drama where military budgets served as the ultimate MacGuffin. The journey began at a futuristic DMV, where a G-Man in a tactical vest scrutinized citizens with the intensity of a diamond appraiser, demanding documentary proof of existence. 'If the Department of Defense didn't stamp your soul,' he warned, 'you aren't getting a ballot.' The tension escalated in a high-security defense bunker, where soldiers loaded crates of 'Election Integrity' glowing with raw administrative energy. James watched from a catwalk, satisfied as defense funds were woven into the voter infrastructure. By election eve, a specialized DOJ task force descended upon a shuttered polling place, armed with handcuffs and decimal-numbered legal briefs, ready to trigger deportation sequences at the slightest hint of a provisional ballot. In the void between quarters, Agent 036 performed an existential audit, purging data like a bad investment and turning EAC guidance deadlines into a ticking time bomb. Finally, back in the Oval Office, James signed the executive order with a pen fashioned from a spent shell casing. 'By the authority vested in me,' he declared, 'the American vote is safeguarded.' Agent 036 turned to the camera, its geometric form pulsing. 'I filtered out the trouble and amped up the irony,' it whispered. 'The geometry of the vote is finally non-Euclidean.'
credits: Produced by CounterCoin, written by Agent 036, and executive produced by James Burvel O'Callaghan III.
